issues.on_page: Charges for services 909,485 (Water 172,349 / Sewer 122,060 / Electric 615,076, proprietary funds)
issues.issue: Utility fund charges belong in the category Utility Charges (user rule 2026-10-28). The report's own detail lines (detail[36-38]) already use Utility Charges, so the receipts line is inconsistent with them.

issues.on_page: Charges for services 168,023 (Statement of Activities: Sanitation 159,672, Park Pool 8,351)
issues.issue: 95% of this governmental line is sanitation (garbage) charges, which fall under Utility Charges per the user rules. The Park Pool part would be Recreation Fees. detail[19] (detail_category 'other charges for services') has the same issue.

issues.on_page: Grants and contributions 69,548 (capital grants and contributions, general government, p2)
issues.issue: The grantor isn't stated, so state aid is an assumption; it could be federal or private (donations/contributions). detail[12] has the same issue.
The line mixes licenses and fees, and the actual is far above budget (1,640). The dominant part is unclear.

issues.on_page: Payroll taxes and benefits 80,834 (Payroll Fund; p2 lists 'Payroll' under general revenues)
issues.issue: The Payroll Fund's receipts are probably charges to the other funds. If so they could be interfund (transfer-like) money that double counts spending. The category is an assumption.

The collection fee is recorded as a negative property tax receipt so the split ties to County treasurer receipts 82,505 (p4). The arithmetic holds (83,084 - 579 = 82,505), but treating a fee as negative revenue is an assumption.

Capital outlay lines should be labelled 'Capital Outlay: <function>' (user rule 2026-10-26); the Street line was relabelled but this General Fund line was not. The business-type capital outlay lines (detail[58-60], receipts-level disbursements[12]) are not relabelled either.
